pose: A visually striking, high-fidelity paleontological layout showcasing the evolutionary spectrum of dinosaur egg coloration, arranged across distinct, beautifully lit ground textures. In the sharp foreground, a well-defined nest of small theropod and oviraptorosaur eggs is highlighted, displaying a vibrant array of non-avian colors—featuring distinct matte blue-green, pale turquoise, and olive-toned eggshells with subtle brown speckled patterns, mimicking modern camouflaged bird eggs. Adjacent to this clutch, a separate nest reveals elongated troodontid eggs with deep cream and warm, sun-baked clay-red pigments. In the midground, a large mound nest features a collection of massive, spherical sauropod and large hadrosaur eggs, rendered in stark, UV-weathered chalky whites, pale grays, and sandy beige tones with highly textured, porous shell details. The scene is illuminated by crisp, dramatic museum-style spotlights that capture the rich variations in pigment, speckling, and surface luster against a clean, neutral slate-grey background for clear gameplay comparison.
